newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil INPC inflation index falls in Nov - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil INPC inflation index falls in Nov - IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian inflation in November as measured by the National Consumer Prices Index (INPC) fell to 0.34 percent against 0.38 percent in October, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The INPC is based on the spending of families earning up to eight minimum salaries.

The Wider Consumer Price Index (IPCA), which measures the spending of families earning up to 40 minimum salaries, registered inflation of 0.32 percent, up from October's 0.30 percent, the IBGE said in a statement.
A 0.32 percent decline in food and beverage prices contributed to the fall in the INPC index, the IBGE said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
